subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: Follow repositories shared by others, pick only what you need and keep it updated.

empty.title: Use configurations shared by others
empty.description: Paste the URL of a repository with skills, agents or instructions and choose exactly what to bring to this PC.
empty.step_share_desc: Someone shares the URL of their repository.
